# Awesome Physics [![Awesome Lists](https://srv-cdn.himpfen.io/badges/awesome-lists/awesomelists-flat.svg)](https://github.com/brandonhimpfen/awesome-lists) [![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/1115459246.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19681720)
[![Support Open Work](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support-Open%20Work-0A0A0A?style=flat&logo=github)](https://github.com/brandonhimpfen/support) [![GitHub Sponsor](https://srv-cdn.himpfen.io/badges/github/github-flat.svg)](https://github.com/sponsors/brandonhimpfen) [![Buy Me a Coffee](https://srv-cdn.himpfen.io/badges/buymeacoffee/buymeacoffee-flat.svg)](https://buymeacoffee.com/brandonhimpfen) [![Ko-Fi](https://srv-cdn.himpfen.io/badges/kofi/kofi-flat.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/brandonhimpfen) [![PayPal](https://srv-cdn.himpfen.io/badges/paypal/paypal-flat.svg)](https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=3LLKRXJU44EJJ)
[![X](https://srv-cdn.himpfen.io/badges/twitter/twitter-flat.svg)](https://x.com/ListsAwesome) [![Facebook](https://srv-cdn.himpfen.io/badges/facebook-pages/facebook-pages-flat.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/awesomelists) 📌 This repository is archived with Zenodo and can be cited using the DOI above. > A curated list of resources for **physics**, including theory, simulation tools, computational frameworks, datasets, open-source software, and learning materials across classical, modern, and applied physics. _Support ongoing maintenance and curation via [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/brandonhimpfen)._ ## Contents - [Foundations & References](#foundations--references) - [Classical Physics](#classical-physics) - [Modern & Theoretical Physics](#modern--theoretical-physics) - [Quantum Physics](#quantum-physics) - [Astrophysics & Cosmology](#astrophysics--cosmology) - [Condensed Matter & Materials Science](#condensed-matter--materials-science) - [Nuclear & Particle Physics](#nuclear--particle-physics) - [Computational Physics](#computational-physics) - [Simulation & Modeling Tools](#simulation--modeling-tools) - [Data, Repositories & Open Science](#data-repositories--open-science) - [Learning Resources](#learning-resources) - [Related Awesome Lists](#related-awesome-lists) ## Foundations & References - [Physics Stack Exchange](https://physics.stackexchange.com/) – Community-driven Q&A for physics theory, problems, and applications. - [NIST Physical Constants](https://physics.nist.gov/constants) – Authoritative reference for fundamental physical constants. - [arXiv Physics](https://arxiv.org/archive/physics) – Open-access repository for physics preprints. - [Encyclopedia of Physics](https://plato.stanford.edu/) – Scholarly reference articles relevant to physical sciences. - [CODATA](https://www.codata.org/) – Internationally recommended values of physical constants. ## Classical Physics - [Classical Mechanics (Goldstein)](https://www.amazon.com/Classical-Mechanics-Herbert-Goldstein/dp/0201657023) – Foundational reference for Newtonian and Lagrangian mechanics. - [MIT OpenCourseWare – Classical Mechanics](https://ocw.mit.edu/) – University-level lectures and notes on mechanics. - [Fluid Mechanics Resources](https://nptel.ac.in/) – Learning materials covering fluid dynamics and hydrodynamics. - [OpenFOAM](https://www.openfoam.com/) – Open-source CFD software for fluid mechanics simulations. - [LAMMPS](https://www.lammps.org/) – Molecular dynamics simulator widely used in classical physics research. ## Modern & Theoretical Physics - [Theoretical Physics Reference](https://arxiv.org/) – Preprints covering advanced theoretical models and frameworks. - [General Relativity Living Reviews](https://link.springer.com/journal/41114) – In-depth reviews of general relativity research. - [Einstein Online](https://www.einstein-online.info/) – Educational portal on relativity and modern physics. - [SymPy Physics](https://docs.sympy.org/latest/modules/physics/index.html) – Symbolic mathematics tools for theoretical physics. ## Quantum Physics - [Quantum Mechanics MIT OCW](https://ocw.mit.edu/) – Lecture notes and problem sets on quantum theory. - [QuTiP](https://qutip.org/) – Open-source Python framework for simulating quantum systems. - [Qiskit](https://qiskit.org/) – Open-source SDK for quantum computing and quantum information. - [Cirq](https://quantumai.google/cirq) – Python library for quantum circuits and algorithms. - [Quantum Open Source Foundation](https://qosf.org/) – Community-driven quantum software and education. ## Astrophysics & Cosmology - [NASA Astrophysics Data System](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/) – Research database for astronomy and astrophysics papers. - [ESA Science](https://www.cosmos.esa.int/) – European Space Agency datasets and mission science. - [Astropy](https://www.astropy.org/) – Python library for astronomy and astrophysics computations. - [CosmoMC](https://cosmologist.info/cosmomc/) – Markov Chain Monte Carlo engine for cosmological parameter estimation. - [HEASARC](https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/) – High-energy astrophysics data archive. ## Condensed Matter & Materials Science - [Materials Project](https://materialsproject.org/) – Open database of material properties from ab initio calculations. - [Quantum ESPRESSO](https://www.quantum-espresso.org/) – Integrated suite for electronic-structure calculations. - [VASP](https://www.vasp.at/) – First-principles simulation package for materials modeling. - [Wannier90](https://wannier.org/) – Tool for electronic structure and Wannier functions. - [AFLOW](https://aflow.org/) – Automatic framework for materials discovery and design. ## Nuclear & Particle Physics - [CERN Open Data Portal](https://opendata.cern.ch/) – Public datasets from LHC experiments. - [Particle Data Group](https://pdg.lbl.gov/) – Definitive resource for particle physics properties. - [ROOT](https://root.cern/) – Data analysis framework used in high-energy physics. - [GEANT4](https://geant4.web.cern.ch/) – Toolkit for simulating particle interactions with matter. - [INSPIRE-HEP](https://inspirehep.net/) – Literature database for high-energy physics. ## Computational Physics - [NumPy](https://numpy.org/) – Core numerical computing library for physics simulations. - [SciPy](https://scipy.org/) – Scientific computing tools for optimization, integration, and signal processing. - [Julia Physics Ecosystem](https://juliaphysics.github.io/) – High-performance physics packages written in Julia. - [MATLAB](https://www.mathworks.com/products/matlab.html) – Numerical computing environment widely used in physics. - [PETSc](https://petsc.org/) – Scalable solvers for large-scale scientific computation. ## Simulation & Modeling Tools - [COMSOL Multiphysics](https://www.comsol.com/) – Finite element simulation platform for physics-based modeling. - [Simulink](https://www.mathworks.com/products/simulink.html) – Model-based design for dynamic systems. - [FEniCS](https://fenicsproject.org/) – Open-source computing platform for PDE-based simulations. - [MOOSE Framework](https://mooseframework.inl.gov/) – Multiphysics simulation framework. - [Elmer FEM](https://www.csc.fi/web/elmer) – Finite element software for multiphysical problems. ## Data, Repositories & Open Science - [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/) – Open repository for scientific data and publications. - [Figshare](https://figshare.com/) – Research data sharing platform. - [Open Science Framework](https://osf.io/) – Collaboration and data management for scientific research. - [Dryad](https://datadryad.org/) – Curated repository for scientific datasets. - [PANGAEA](https://www.pangaea.de/) – Earth and environmental science data archive. ## Learning Resources ### Tutorials - [MIT OpenCourseWare Physics](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/physics/) – Free university-level physics courses. - [Khan Academy Physics](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/physics) – Beginner-friendly physics tutorials. - [Physics LibreTexts](https://phys.libretexts.org/) – Open-access physics textbooks and learning modules. ### Guides - [HyperPhysics](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/) – Conceptual physics reference with visual explanations. - [The Feynman Lectures](https://www.feynmanlectures.caltech.edu/) – Classic lectures on physics fundamentals. - [Physics Today](https://physicstoday.scitation.org/) – News and analysis in modern physics research. ### Courses - *Classical Mechanics* – Undergraduate-level mechanics curriculum. - *Quantum Mechanics* – Core course covering wave mechanics and operators. - *Statistical Mechanics* – Course on thermodynamics and ensemble theory. ## Related Awesome Lists - [Awesome Mathematics](https://github.com/brandonhimpfen/awesome-mathematics) - [Awesome Quantum Computing](https://github.com/brandonhimpfen/awesome-quantum-computing) - [Awesome Data Science](https://github.com/brandonhimpfen/awesome-data-science) - [Awesome Scientific Computing](https://github.com/brandonhimpfen/awesome-scientific-computing) ## Contribute Contributions are welcome. Please ensure your submission fully follows the requirements outlined in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md), including formatting, scope alignment, and category placement.
